channel.title: Nick Shaw — Blog
channel.description: Articles on software testing, QA engineering, web development, and AI-assisted development by Nick Shaw.

item.title: Rebuilding the site with Claude Code
item.description: A full redesign and rebuild of this portfolio using React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Claude Code as a genuine development partner — what we built, how we worked, and what it felt like.

item.title: AI and Agent Skills
item.description: Completing Anthropic’s Claude 101, Claude Code in Action, and Introduction to Agent Skills courses — plus applying AI-assisted development with Playwright MCP in real delivery work.

item.title: CSPO: Product Owner
item.description: Earning the Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) qualification — the course, key learnings, and how combining Product Owner and ScrumMaster perspectives improves delivery.

item.title: Japan and a new PC
item.description: Back from an unforgettable trip to Japan — Tokyo, Mt Fuji, Kyoto, Nara and Hiroshima — plus setting up a new PC and looking ahead to the Amalfi Coast and Matera.

item.title: Site redesign
item.description: A total site rebuild in React — exploring component architecture, CSS keyframe animations, and what it’s like to dive into a React rabbit-hole during a widespread power outage.

item.title: Setting up Playwright in VS Code for automated testing
item.description: A step-by-step guide to setting up Playwright for automated testing in VS Code, covering installation of Node.js, Git, VS Code extensions, and running your first tests.

item.title: JavaScript (and TypeScript, a little...)
item.description: Progress with JavaScript fundamentals through FreeCodeCamp, building mini projects like a colour flipper and calculator, and an early look at TypeScript.

item.title: Getting started
item.description: An introduction to the site, the plan to document a journey into test automation, and a list of the most useful YouTube channels found along the way.
